Garage description
An interesting approach to urban camouflage. Pretending to be a victim of street hooligans, your tank perfectly merges with the residential areas of concrete jungles.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on February 6, 2015.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Graffiti was worth 250,000 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Generalissimo.
Legacy paint description:
The paint with the best protection against Vulcan. Also deals well with damage from Twins and Shaft. Will come in handy at mid to long ranges. Gives your tank a street art look.
